title: Built with Claude
intro: The projects show what I've built. This is how I build — how I put my skills to work, and the reusable systems I've made to ship real products fast without ever dropping the quality bar.

sections.title: Vibe engineering, end to end
sections.body: I work with AI as a builder, not a chatbot. I describe a real problem I'm living with, then direct the agent to explore the codebase, write the code, run the tests and deploy — while I keep the judgment: the architecture calls, the trade-offs, and an explicit human yes on anything that spends money or ships to users.
points: Problem in, working software out — I direct, review and decide
Architecture, data modelling and API design stay my calls
Every spend, publish or push passes an explicit human approval

sections.title: Reusable skills I've built
sections.body: To make the workflow repeatable, I've packaged my process into reusable agent skills — so the same house-quality bar and launch baseline apply automatically on every project, not from memory.
points: Ticket-to-PR automation: implement, self-review against my conventions, prep the PR
A one-command 'solve' that drives implement → test → review end to end
PR review, comment-resolution and summary skills in a consistent house style
Ship-hands-free: use standing credentials to do the work and hand back only the human steps

sections.title: The craft is still mine
sections.body: The AI moves fast; the taste and engineering judgment are mine. I bring senior frontend craft to every build so the result feels considered, not generated — from component architecture to the motion and 3D that make it memorable.
points: React + TypeScript component architecture and reusable design systems
Motion & 3D (Framer Motion, Three.js) used with restraint, for meaning not noise
Accessibility, responsive mobile-first layouts and Core-Web-Vitals performance

sections.title: Standards I never skip
sections.body: Speed is worthless if it ships something fragile or dishonest. Every project inherits the same non-negotiables from commit one, enforced by my skills rather than left to chance.
points: SEO-first: metadata, Open Graph, sitemap, robots, JSON-LD and clean semantic HTML
Cloudflare-secured deploys with SSL and sensible security defaults
Honest by design — I show the real numbers, including when they're unflattering
